name: codeck
description: A Codex presentation room plugin that routes one user-facing skill through outline, design, review, export, and speech lanes.

interface.shortDescription: Create, review, export, and present self-contained HTML decks from a persistent deck room.
interface.longDescription: codeck opens a project-local presentation workbench, scans source materials, routes work through fixed outline/design/review/export/speech lanes, and produces a self-contained HTML deck with presenter and editor modes. The plugin ships the fixed runtime and deterministic scripts; each user's deck state stays in their own project room.
defaultPrompt: Use codeck to make a presentation from this project.
Open the codeck deck editor for the latest deck.
Review the latest codeck deck and fix scoped issues.
Export the latest codeck deck to PDF.
